android_mechanism: Cache/data structure grows without bound; fix bounds the retained data
bug_description: The search-history store persists every keyword as its own preference key and never bounds the number of entries. The history grows without limit, the history component renders an ever-growing ForEach, and preferences storage/flush volume grows with every search.
fix_summary: History is kept as a single ordered JSON list capped at the 20 most recent keywords.
trigger_steps: Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, disk); open the search page so the history component renders.
Stop hitrace; record preference file size (hdc shell 'du /data/app/el2/100/base/com.itcast.pass_interview/.../preferences/').
Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Number of history entries retained after 60 searches, size of the preferences file, and CPU/time to render the history component when the search page opens.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed retains 60+ entries and growing render/storage cost; fixed retains 20. unfixed history-component build cost and preferences size > fixed.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 20 app sched disk ace -o /data/local/tmp/ia_hist.chtrace
